title: Intel shares fall as Trump’s taxpayer-backed investment loses value
teaser: Intel shares fell after the Trump administration invested taxpayer money in the chipmaker, putting a volatile stock price at the center of a larger bet on the company’s future. The decline came after Intel’s fourth-quarter revenue forecast fell short of Wall Street expectations, wiping $150 billion from its market value. It also exposed the tension in the government’s position: the value of its investment moves with a company still trying to resolve weak PC demand and manufacturing problems.
